summary: Tested new Meetings-page lazy-load feature (month-summary endpoint + year/month filter on GET /meetings) across all 4 role branches, plus frontend collapse/expand/search integration. 13/13 backend tests pass. Frontend flows all work: current month renders fully expanded, past months collapsed with status breakdown, expand lazy-fetches with skeleton, second expand is instant (no refetch), search/filter transparently pulls full history.

issues: Unknown/legacy status values (e.g. 'scheduled') fall through the STATUS_CONFIG lookup and render as the raw lowercase status name in the breakdown text (saw 'August 2026 · ... · 1 scheduled'). formatStatusBreakdown() should either hide unknowns or Title-Case them. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: teach formatStatusBreakdown() (or STATUS_CONFIG) to handle unknown statuses like 'scheduled' (currently renders as raw lowercase word).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/meetings.py: /month-summary is correctly registered BEFORE the /{meeting_id} dynamic route (line 398 vs 483) — no shadowing.
COALESCE(date, created_at) BETWEEN clause consistently added to all 4 role branches of _list_meetings_data — verified via passing tests for admin, org-manager (manager@ is org-level), and attendee.

GET /meetings/?year=2026 (year without month) returns unfiltered list because the code only applies date filter when BOTH year AND month are set (line 243). Semantically fine but silently ignoring a partially-set filter could mask a frontend bug — consider raising 422 if only one of year/month is provided.

Meetings.js chip counts (Draft 19, In Review 6, etc.) reflect activeMeetingsLoaded (only current month + any manually expanded months), so the numbers on the chips 'change' after a filter triggers the full-history fetch. Not incorrect, but slightly confusing UX — consider using allMeetings when hasActiveFilters, otherwise activeMeetingsLoaded, for chip counts too.

The 15s meeting-status poll now re-fetches all currently loaded months in a Promise.all — fine for typical 1-3 months open, but if a user expands many months during a long session, poll fanout grows linearly. Consider debouncing or only polling months that actually contain processing/transcribing/analyzing meetings.
